content: Bulurrum YAWEI
Wal det sabibala bin kipgon tok, “Wal main biginini, yu nomo fogedabat wanim aibin oldei titjimbat yu. Yu garra kipum ol detlot wed langa yu main,
wulijim yu garra jidan laibala longtaim en yu laif garra jidan brabli gudwan.
Yu garra jidan brabli trubala en yu garra kain langa ebribodi en yu garra shoum ebribodi yu gin dum gudbala ting. Yu garra kipum ol dislot wed langa yu main.
If yu dum lagijat wal God en ola pipul garra brabli gudbinji langa yu.
“Yu garra trastim YAWEI det trubala God garram yu hat holbit. Nomo reken miselp blanga dum ebrijing yuselp.
Yu jinggabat langa YAWEI blanga ebrijing weya yu dum en im garra shoum yu det raitwei.
Nomo reken miselp yu sabi blanga dumbat ola gudwan klebabala ting. Yu garra teiknodis en rispek langa YAWEI en yu nomo dumbat nogudbala ting.
If yu dum lagijat, wal im jis laik medisin blanga meigim yu gudwan brom ola sowa langa yu bodi en deigidawei ola pein.
Yu garra shoum rispek langa YAWEI en gibit im ol detlot feswan frut daga en sid daga weya yu gajim brom yu fam,
wulijim yu fam garra jidan garram olkain frut daga en detlot nyuwan wain garra jidan raitful langa detlot wodadram.
“Main biginini, yu garra teiknodis langa YAWEI en yu nomo gitwail wen im gibit yu woning blanga dum rait ting.
YAWEI oldei gibit woning langa detlot pipul weya im laigim jis laik det dediwan wen im gibit woning langa im biginini olabat weya im laigim.
“Wal detlot pipul hu sabi dumbat ola gudwan klebabala ting garra jidan brabli hepiwan en olabat garra jidan gudbinji blanga len mowa.
If yu klebabala wal im mobeda den if yu jidan brabli ritjwan garram silba en gol.
If yu sabi hau blanga dum ola sabibalawan ting wal im mobeda langa ola purdiwan ston. Nomo enijing weya yu wandimbat kaan jidan lebul langa im.
Det brabli sabibalawan im meigim yu jidan laibala longtaim en im meigim yu jidan ritjwan en im meigim yu jidan haibala.
Det brabli sabibalawan meigim yu jidan brabli gudbalawei, nomo garram eni trabul.
Detlot pipul hu jidan sabibala garra jidan gudbinji. Det gudbinjiwei garra gibit olabat laif.
“Wal garram det sabibalawei blanga im, YAWEI bin meigim dijan wel, en imbin sabi hau blanga pudum det skai langa im pleis.
Garram im sabibalawei imbin meigim detlot riba kamat en imbin meigim detlot klaud jandimdan rein langa dijan graun.
“Wal main biginini, yu garra oldei jinggabat en dum ola gudwan klebabala ting. Nomo fogedabat detlot.
Jis laik wen yu werrimon det tjein langa yu nek blanga meigim yu luk brabli gudwan, wal lagijat du wen yu lisin en teiknodis langa ol dislot wed dei garra meigim yu jidan gudbalawei,
en yu garra jidan seifwan en najing kaan ardim yu.
Yu kaan bradin blanga enijing wen yu silip. Wen yu silip langa yu sweig yu garra silip brabli gudbalawei.
Yu kaan wori wen trabul kaman kwikbala langa yu, en yu kaan bradin wen detlot nogudbala ting kaman langa detlot nogudbala pipul,
dumaji YAWEI det trubala God na garra oldei maindimbat yu. Im na garra oldei lukaftumbat yu wulijim yu kaan git trep.
“Wal wen pipul wandim yu blanga album olabat yu garra duwit gudbinjiwei.
If yu fren askim yu blanga album im yu kaan dalim im, ‘Yu weit! Ai garra album yu tumorro.’ Nomo. Yu kaan tok lagijat. Yu garra duwit streidawei.
Yu nomo meigim plen blanga ardim yu fren. Im jidan gulijap langa yu en im oldei trastim yu.
Yu nomo agamin langa enibodi wen im nomo bin dum enijing blanga ardim yu.
Yu nomo git jelas langa enibodi hu oldei faitfaitbat, en yu nomo jidan wulijim olabat,
dumaji YAWEI nomo laigim detlot pipul hu oldei dumbat rong ting, bat im jidan fren langa detlot pipul hu oldei jidan trubalawei.
“Wal YAWEI garra tok brabli strongbala wed blanga meigim trabul blanga detlot nogudbala femili, bat im garra tok brabli gudbala wed blanga album detlot femili hu oldei dumbat ebrijing raitwei.
YAWEI nomo laigim detlot pipul hu oldei meigim miselp haibala, bat im jidan kainwan langa detlot pipul hu meigim miselp lobala.
Ola sabibala pipul garra jidan haibala, bat detlot nogudbala pipul garra jidan nogudbinji en dei garra jidan sheimwan du.”
